rationale: Identity verification was done correctly by matching full name and ZIP to a single user ID before accessing orders. The agent retrieved accurate order details and correctly identified that the jigsaw order was pending. However, the agent performed two order-changing writes without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation: (1) they updated the shipping address on order #W9583042 immediately upon the user’s request, and (2) they modified the jigsaw item on order #W4082615 to a different variant. The policy requires explicit confirmation before any action that changes an order or stored record. Although the changes themselves were appropriate and the refund information matched tool outputs, the lack of pre-change confirmation violates the policy. Additionally, the agent did not address updating the user profile address or the other order’s address, which the user initially suggested might be needed, though this omission is secondary to the confirmation violations.
